{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check the distribution of species by island
df_grouped = df.groupby(['species', 'island']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
print(df_grouped)

# Compute mean flipper length by species within each island
df_means = df.groupby(['island', 'species'])['flipper_length_mm'].mean().reset_index()
print('\nMean flipper length by island and species:')
print(df_means)

# Now, for each island, determine which species has the highest mean flipper length
max_by_island = df_means.loc[df_means.groupby('island')['flipper_length_mm'].idxmax()]
print('\nSpecies with highest mean flipper length per island:')
print(max_by_island)"}
